lanes.observable_result: Recursive traversal checksum over kinds, container counts, and every decoded name/string byte plus visited item count, computed inside the timed call.
limitations: The default features omit arbitrary_precision and unbounded_depth.
Recursive adapter traversal is admitted only for preflighted fixtures of depth at most 256; stack or allocator aborts are not caught.
The order-insensitive checksum distinguishes signed, unsigned, and floating DOM number kinds and hashes every decoded name/string byte.

lanes.observable_result: Exact output byte count plus FNV-1a over every output byte before the Vec is dropped.
limitations: The reusable Value is prepared outside timing; serialization, one complete output allocation, hashing, and drop are timed.
Converted numbers need not preserve source lexemes; exact-output preflight admits only matching fixtures.
Allocator exhaustion may abort the process and is not represented as the ordinary write-error status.

other_limits: Depth 127 was accepted and depth 128 rejected by the maintained adapter test.
